d: An anthropomorphic creature with reddish-brown fur and a bulky, powerful build, featuring a tufted crest of spiky reddish-brown hair and small, dark, focused eyes. The face is mature and rugged, with a snout and a small gold earring. The attire consists of heavy, oversized plated armor in a palette of stark white, royal blue, and polished gold, featuring massive curved gauntlets with orange accents and a gold chestplate. BODY COLOR: Reddish-brown
